lines.text: Hit me up if you need help.

data.define: To contact someone by text or call.

example.text: Hit me up if you need help.

misuse.text: Don't say 'hit me up' to your professor.

publish.title: What does "hit me up" mean?
publish.value: Hit me up = Send me a message. Example: "Hit me up if you need help." (very casual English, US).
